GOLF ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 4, 2025
  2760 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  PRM ADMINISTRATION, LARGE CONFERENCE ROOM, 2:30 PM

Kevin Fitzgerald, Chair  Jim Demetriou, Member
Larry Conkings, Vice Chair  Robert Meliere, Member
Clifford Aichele, Member  Joyce Ricci, Member
Stevie Anderson, Member  Angie Young, Member
Donna Barrett, Member

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  LILIA.ROMERO@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56304  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Golf Advisory Committee meeting
  of Thursday, June 5, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

2.  25-56305  Recommendation to receive and file the City Golf Operations oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

3.  25-56306  Recommendation to receive and file the American Golf oral updates on the
  courses, capital improvement projects, and the Long Beach Golf Festival.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

4.  25-56307  Recommendation to discuss and, if appropriate, recommend the Director approve
  the updated Golf Operations Manual, with two revisions, as endorsed by the
  Policies and Procedures Ad Hoc Committee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

5.  25-56308  Recommendation to review and approve the Golf Advisory Committee’s 2024
  Annual Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

6.  25-56309  Recommendation to consider the establishment of additional Ad Hoc Committees
  and/or dissolution of existing Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

  Page 1 of 2
   GOLF ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 4, 2025
  2760 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  PRM ADMINISTRATION, LARGE CONFERENCE ROOM, 2:30 PM

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Golf Advisory Committee on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited
to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Lilia Romero, Clerk Typist III, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the
meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Lilia Romero at (562) 248-8795
or lilia.romero@longbeach.gov.
